mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory (user_id, kb_id, content, confidence, score, memory_key, source_turn_id, tags, is_deleted, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, access_count, last_accessed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kbId}, #{content}, #{confidence}, #{score}, #{memoryKey}, #{sourceTurnId}, #{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, #{isDeleted}, #{expiresAt}, NOW(), NOW(), #{accessCount}, #{lastAccessedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory SET user_id = #{userId}, kb_id = #{kbId}, content = #{content}, confidence = #{confidence}, score = #{score}, memory_key = #{memoryKey}, source_turn_id = #{sourceTurnId}, tags = #{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = NOW(), access_count = #{accessCount}, last_accessed_at = #{lastAccessedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_memory SET is_deleted = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_memory m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND (#{kbId} = 0 OR m.kb_id = #{kbId}) AND m.is_deleted = false AND (m.expires_at IS NULL OR m.expires_at > #{now})
AND LOWER(m.content) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))

SELECT * FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (#{kbId} = 0 OR kb_id = #{kbId}) AND is_deleted = false AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND (embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) <= #{maxDistance} ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) LIMIT 1
